articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and 3D Assets
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, video streams, and 3D scene graphs in a single context window of 1M tokens. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-Bench Full and near-human performance on novel spatial reasoning tasks. The model is available via API with tiered rate limits and represents a significant leap in unified cross-modal understanding.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Silver Medal Performance on International Mathematics Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2, using a refined chain-of-thought verification pipeline and Monte Carlo tree search over proof steps, solved 4 out of 6 problems on the 2026 IMO problem set—equivalent to a silver medal. This marks a significant milestone in formal mathematical reasoning by LLMs. The team published a companion paper detailing a novel self-verification mechanism that dramatically reduces hallucinated proof steps.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Atlas Gen-3 with Dexterous Bi-Manual Manipulation for Warehouse Logistics
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics revealed the third generation of its electric Atlas humanoid robot, featuring redesigned hands with 20 degrees of freedom per manipulator and tactile sensing at the fingertip level. The robot demonstrated autonomous bin-picking and palletizing of irregular objects at near-human speed in a live warehouse demo. The company announced pilot deployments with DHL and Amazon beginning Q1 2027.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Closes $1.5B Series C, Demonstrates Autonomous Figure 03 Performing Multi-Step Assembly Tasks
articles.summary: Figure Robotics raised $1.5 billion at a $15B valuation led by Microsoft and Bezos Expeditions, showcasing its Figure 03 humanoid performing end-to-end electronics assembly tasks learned entirely through demonstration and reinforcement learning. The system uses a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on proprietary manipulation data. CEO Brett Adcock stated the company aims to deploy 1,000 units to manufacturing partners by mid-2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' for Real-Time Enterprise AI Safety Guardrails
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new production-ready safety framework called Constitutional Classifiers, allowing enterprise customers to define custom behavioral boundaries for Claude deployments using natural language constitutions that compile to lightweight classifier heads. The system adds less than 15ms of latency per request and reduces policy violations by 94% in red-team evaluations. The framework is open-sourced and compatible with other foundation model providers.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node with Backside Power Delivery
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed it has started risk production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at Fab 18 in Tainan, featuring backside power delivery network technology that improves standard cell density by 15% and reduces IR drop significantly. Early test chips show 20% performance gains over N2 at iso-power. Apple and Nvidia are reported to be lead customers with high-volume production targeted for late 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Expanded Access Approval for Motor Cortex BCI in Quadriplegic Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink expanded access approval to implant its N2 brain-computer interface in up to 50 quadriplegic patients, following positive results from its initial cohort showing sustained cursor and robotic arm control over 12 months with minimal signal degradation. The approval represents a significant regulatory milestone for consumer-grade neural interfaces. Competing efforts from Synchron and Paradromics are also advancing through clinical trials.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture Rivaling Closed-Source Frontier Models
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, a 288B-parameter active (1.2T total) mixture-of-experts model that matches or exceeds GPT-5 on multiple benchmarks including MMLU-Pro, HumanEval+, and GPQA Diamond. The model is fully open-weight under a permissive license and includes optimized inference kernels for single-node deployment on 8xH200 setups. The release intensifies the debate around open vs. closed AI development as open models reach true frontier capability.
